selection_policy.root_documents: Root Markdown/reStructuredText and license/notice/copyright files, excluding agent control files.
selection_policy.documentation_trees: Tracked non-hidden files under doc/docs/documentation directories, excluding tests and vendored dependencies; msdebug restricted to its top-level docs tree.
selection_policy.supplemental_documents: Non-hidden Markdown/reStructuredText outside documentation trees, excluding tests, vendored dependencies and agent control files; msdebug restricted to example/ outside docs/.
selection_policy.linked_resources: Existing regular-file targets of static relative Markdown/HTML links, subject to the same hidden/test/vendor/control exclusions.
selection_policy.submodules: Not traversed. Each selected tool repository is independently fetched from its own 26.2.0 branch.
selection_policy.content_transformations: Regular files preserve upstream Git blob bytes. Git LFS pointers are expanded to their original payloads and verified against the pointer SHA-256 and size.
